entries.prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of a rainy city crosswalk at blue hour, wet asphalt reflecting shop lights. A colossal plain white sneaker with no logo, the size of a bus, drops from the overcast sky and lands on the crosswalk with a heavy impact, throwing a wave of puddle water and shaking the street lamps; pedestrians with umbrellas, seen from behind, stop and look up. Low angle, a short camera shake on impact, then a slow tilt up along the shoe. 24mm lens, realistic scale, photorealistic, faux out-of-home ad style.

First-person POV, handheld action-camera footage walking into a bustling ancient Mediterranean harbor market at sunrise, about 2,000 years ago: wooden merchant ships with linen sails behind, stalls stacked with amphorae, figs and fish, merchants in wool tunics seen from behind and in profile calling out, a goat crossing the path, dust glowing in low golden light. Natural head bob, slight wide-angle distortion, documentary travel-vlog feel, 16mm lens.

Extreme close-up, vertical: a sharp chef's knife slowly slices through a dome cake made of translucent ruby-red glass on a white marble board. The blade crunches through with crisp crackling; the cut reveals a glowing layered interior of amber and pink glass like jelly, and thin shards tinkle onto the board. Soft diffused top light, glossy reflections, 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, static camera. Audio: crisp glass crunch, tinkling shards, no music.

Grainy black-and-white night-vision security camera footage, fixed high wide angle looking down on a suburban backyard. Three raccoons climb a children's plastic slide one after another and slide down; the last one tumbles off the end, rolls, gets up and runs back to the ladder for another turn. Infrared glow, slight fisheye distortion, compression artifacts, white timestamp "02:14:37" in the top corner, static camera. Audio: crickets, soft plastic thumps.

Inside a softly lit refrigerator at night, photorealistic anthropomorphic fruit characters with subtle expressive faces: a glossy lemon with wide, teary eyes turns slowly toward a ripe avocado sitting beside it on the glass shelf. The lemon whispers, "You told me you were ripe." The avocado looks away, ashamed. Dramatic soap-opera close-up, slow push-in, cool blue fridge light with a warm rim light, condensation on the shelf, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Audio: a dramatic violin sting over a low fridge hum.

Macro tilt-shift shot, vertical: on a real cast-iron pan on a kitchen stove, a team of thumb-sized chefs in white uniforms cook breakfast. Two roll a cherry tomato like a boulder, one cracks a quail egg as big as himself onto the sizzling pan, another flips a strip of bacon with full-body effort. Warm kitchen light, rising steam, 100mm macro, shallow depth of field, hyper-real miniature world. Audio: sizzling oil, tiny clinks.

Epic wide shot at golden-hour sunset: a colossal humpback whale glides slowly through a sea of glowing clouds above a modern city skyline, sunlight streaming through its fins, a flock of birds and a tiny airplane pass beneath it, people on a rooftop in silhouette point up. The camera tracks smoothly alongside the whale. Photorealistic, awe-inspiring scale, cinematic blockbuster look.

Premium 3D product commercial, wide shot: a sleek matte-black sneaker with no logo floats and slowly rotates in a dark studio, then bursts in slow motion into thousands of glowing neon paint droplets in electric blue, magenta and lime that swirl around the camera and snap back together into the shoe. Hard rim light, glossy reflections, ultra sharp, high-end ad energy. Audio: deep whoosh, liquid splash, bass hit.

Macro shot of a glass snow globe on a dark desk; inside it a tiny neon city at night is alive: miniature flying cars streak between skyscrapers, lights flicker, snow swirls. The camera pushes in smoothly through the glass into the tiny streets. Magical, hyper-detailed, cinematic, wide 16:9. Audio: soft magical chimes and a distant city hum.

Handheld smartphone-style video on a busy sunny city street: a friendly golden retriever the size of a three-storey building walks calmly between the buildings, wagging its tail; pedestrians stop, laugh and film it on their phones, a bus passes under its belly. Realistic scale, viral social-media clip look, wide 16:9. Audio: crowd gasps and laughter, a deep happy woof.

Oddly satisfying macro food commercial: glossy molten dark chocolate pours onto a white marble surface and sculpts itself into a perfect chocolate rose whose petals unfurl and bloom, a dusting of gold flakes falls and sparkles. Soft top light, mirror-like gloss, slow motion, wide 16:9. Audio: thick silky pour, soft crackle, no music.

Slow cinematic drone glide over an endless sea of clouds at sunrise. Jagged dark mountain ridges rise through the cloud layer, golden light rakes across the cloud tops and thin mist streams over the ridges. One smooth, steady forward camera move, no cuts. Anamorphic 35mm film look, rich contrast, photorealistic, epic scale.

Aerial drone tracking shot of a vintage white camper van driving along a winding coastal cliff road at golden hour, turquoise ocean waves breaking below, long shadows, warm sun flare, smooth steady camera following the van, cinematic travel-vlog look. Audio: wind and distant surf, no music.

The perfume bottle comes alive: amber liquid inside swirls and glows, a slow wave of water rises and wraps around the bottle in a glossy spiral, droplets hang in the air and sparkle, then the camera slowly orbits around it. Luxury commercial, dramatic rim light, slow motion. Audio: deep elegant whoosh, water shimmer, no music.

The photo comes alive: the huge wave explodes against the rocks and the spray rises and falls in slow motion, the lighthouse beam sweeps across the sea through the mist, storm clouds roll, sea foam drains off the rocks. Camera holds steady with a slight push-in. Cinematic, photorealistic.

Luxury perfume bottle of faceted amber glass standing on wet black stone, splashes of water frozen mid-air around it, dramatic rim light, dark moody background, high-end product advertising photograph, no readable text or logos.

Square studio product photograph: a small retro robot made of brushed aluminium and orange enamel holds a tiny film clapperboard, soft gradient backdrop, rim light, glossy reflections, playful and premium, no readable text.

Dramatic photograph of a lone lighthouse on a rocky headland at dusk, a huge wave exploding against the rocks, its beam cutting through sea spray, brooding storm clouds with a sliver of orange light on the horizon, cinematic, no text.

Vibrant evening street market photographed at eye level, strings of warm bulbs overhead, stalls of colorful fruit, spices and textiles, steam rising from a food stall, people blurred in motion, rich bokeh, cinematic color, no readable text or logos.

Wide cinematic landscape photograph of rolling green hills and a winding river valley at sunrise, low mist pooling in the folds, soft golden backlight, a few trees on the ridgelines, painterly depth, no text.

Cinematic photograph of a futuristic city at night seen from a rooftop, rain-slick streets glowing with teal and magenta neon, light trails of traffic far below, haze and volumetric light between skyscrapers, ultra detailed, moody, no readable text or logos.

Cinematic wide photograph of a huge full moon rising behind a lone silhouetted hilltop tree, deep blue night sky with faint stars, thin luminous clouds crossing the moon, telephoto compression, crisp detail, quiet and majestic, no text.

Golden hour photograph of sweeping sand dunes, sharp sculpted ridgelines casting long shadows, warm amber light, a tiny lone traveler walking along the crest for scale, fine sand blowing off the ridge, cinematic, no text.

Top-down shot of an open notebook on a wooden desk under a warm lamp. A pencil doodle of a small cartoon dragon blinks, wiggles, peels itself off the paper as a living paper creature, stretches its wings and flies in a loop around the desk lamp, leaving a trail of tiny glowing sparks. Playful, magical, crisp macro detail. Audio: paper rustle, tiny wing flaps, a cute roar.

Street-level cinematic shot at a city traffic light at dusk: a glossy pastel-pink sports car with no logos slowly melts like ice cream into a shiny puddle on the asphalt, pedestrians stare in disbelief; when the light turns green the puddle snaps back up into the car and it drives away. Photoreal, slow motion, wet reflections. Audio: city ambience, a gooey melt, an engine roar.

Vertical product commercial: a frosted block of ice on black glass cracks and shatters in extreme slow motion, revealing an unbranded aluminium soda can covered in condensation; a burst of fizz and droplets erupts upward and freezes in mid-air, sharp rim light, high-end ad energy. Audio: ice crack, can hiss, deep bass hit.

Vertical phone-video look, rooftop party at night with string lights: a cool cat in sunglasses DJs behind turntables while a crowd of animals — a raccoon, a goose, a capybara and a fox — dance; the beat drops and confetti bursts over the city skyline. Fun, viral social clip energy. Audio: house beat drop, crowd cheering.

Wide cinematic shot: a whole city folds itself out of white paper at golden hour — origami skyscrapers unfold upward, bridges crease into place, paper cars roll out and a flock of paper cranes takes off across the sky; the camera glides forward through the newly folded streets. Magical, crisp paper texture, warm light. Audio: soft paper folding sounds, gentle wind.

Vertical macro tilt-shift shot: a crew of tiny construction workers in orange vests on miniature scaffolding repairs the cracked screen of a giant smartphone lying on a desk; one welds with bright sparks, two carry a glass panel, a tiny crane lifts a pixel. Playful, detailed, warm light. Audio: tiny hammering, welding hiss, cheerful whistles.

A small glass jar sits on a dark kitchen table at night; inside it a miniature thunderstorm churns with dark clouds and rain, and bright lightning bolts flash inside the jar, lighting up the whole kitchen in white flashes; the camera slowly pushes in. Atmospheric, magical realism. Audio: tiny thunder rumbles, rain patter.

Premium tech commercial: a pair of unbranded matte-black over-ear headphones assembles itself in mid-air from floating parts — drivers, cushions, metal arms and screws drift in and click together in sequence in a clean dark studio, then the finished headphones spin to a hero pose with a soft blue rim light. Audio: precise mechanical clicks, a low synth swell.

One continuous shot: the camera plunges from Earth orbit through bright clouds, over a glittering night city grid, down between neon skyscrapers and lands at street level in front of a steaming street-food stall in the rain. Seamless, fast but smooth, photorealistic, epic scale.

Instagram-style product ad, vertical: an unbranded glass bottle of cold-brew coffee on ice cubes splashing, deep brown and cream palette, clean studio light, headline text reading "WAKE UP LOUDER" in heavy condensed type, small text "cold brew, no compromise". Premium advertising photography.

Cinematic YouTube thumbnail, 16:9: a shocked young explorer with wide eyes and mouth open in the foreground, behind him a colossal ancient stone face emerging from a jungle cliff, golden rim light, bold saturated colors, big readable headline text "IT WAS REAL" on the right side. Hyper-detailed, high contrast.

Playful 3D typographic artwork: the word "NIGHTSHIFT" built from glossy inflatable balloon letters floating over a midnight-blue city skyline, stars and neon reflections, soft studio lighting, high detail.

The photo comes alive: heavy rain starts falling over the neon city, neon signs flicker on, light trails of traffic streak along the wet street far below, a flying drone crosses the frame, mist drifts between the towers. Camera slowly pushes in. Cinematic, photorealistic.

Vertical phone video filmed by a passer-by at street level on a busy city avenue: a ginger cat, at colossal scale and taller than the buildings, walks slowly down the street between the towers. Cars stop, tiny people look up and point, pigeons scatter. Handheld camera with natural shake that tilts up to follow it, bright slightly overexposed daylight, believable scale and real-world physics, photoreal. No text, no captions.

Close-up of a glass snow globe on a wooden table by a window at dusk. Inside the globe is a tiny, perfectly detailed miniature world of a tiny volcano erupting. A hand gently lifts the globe and shakes it; snowflakes swirl around the miniature and slowly settle while warm fairy lights glow in the background bokeh. Macro lens, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, realistic glass refraction, cosy mood. No text.

Extreme macro close-up, oddly satisfying: glossy pink clay sculpts itself on a clean turntable. It flows, folds and smooths into a perfect symmetrical shape with crisp edges, as if shaped by invisible hands, then holds still for a beat. Slow, smooth, continuous motion, soft diffused studio light, rich texture detail, shallow depth of field, calm and hypnotic, seamless loop. No hands, no tools, no text.

One continuous camera move with no cuts: the shot opens in orbit high above the Earth at sunrise, then dives straight down through thin clouds, over the landscape and the rooftops, and lands smoothly at street level in the old town of Bukhara, ending on a calm eye-level view of everyday life there. Smooth motion that accelerates and then slows gently at the end, realistic geography and light, photoreal, cinematic. No text, no map labels.

A frozen moment in time: a skateboarder mid-jump over a puddle, completely still in mid-action, with droplets, dust and hair hanging motionless in the air. The camera makes one smooth 360-degree orbit around the frozen scene at eye level, showing it from every side, while nothing in the scene moves. Crisp detail, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, photoreal, no motion blur, no text.

Cinematic wide shot for a viral YouTube video about football in the year 2050. A night final in a futuristic floating stadium hovering above a glowing neon city: players in luminous kits sprint, one strikes a powerful volley and the ball streaks across the frame leaving a trail of light, camera drones fly alongside, a giant holographic replay forms in the sky and the crowd erupts. Dynamic sweeping camera, epic scale, photoreal, crisp detail, rich neon and stadium light. No text, no captions, no logos, no real people.
